result:
Done. PR #168 is green, ready, and mergeable; the report is on #10.

## What I found

`blocked_on`'s "NO MECHANISM IN HAND" is **false for Y8/AY8/A8Y8**, and the same mechanism owns most of the suite.

**The mechanism: hardware truncates the luminance-scaled colour to 8 bits; we round it.** Localised by `Bump_map`, which binds the same texture and reads the same offset channels with the same bump matrix, differing only in having no luminance stage — `BumpMap_Y8/_AY8/_A8Y8` are at the floor (310/422/422/422, zero one-step) while `BumpEnvLum_Y8` is 7,139/7,441/7,301/7,501. The non-one-step part of those (310/422/422/422) *is* that floor exactly.

The values are computable from test literals: SZ_Y8 stores 46 and 47, the quad straddles the step. Truncated, both give (23,23,23) — the golden. Rounded, L=47 gives **(24,23,23)** — our exact second colour.

New `bump_lum_oracle.py` scores it: **every `quant=round` row refused on every real-luminance format under all five luminance readings — 25 rows, no exceptions**; `quant=trunc` exact. Four independent luminances agree (1.0, 0x45, 0x7f/0x80, 46/47), and the literal-ONE gate passes for all 15 rivals.

**The entry's own `blocker_falsifier` was the wrong shape.** It expects concentration in the flagged quads. A colour quantiser can't see a sign flag, so the even spread *confirms* this mechanism. That assumption would have licensed calling the class blocked again — worth amending.

**R16B16** splits: the dominant error is the same truncation; the remainder is that the golden's colour histogram is identical in all four quads (7,439/7,095) while ours changes with the flags — a filtering defect. **YUV** is neither: its golden is green-dominant, and since the luminance scales all three channels by one scalar and both env texels are red-dominant, *no* luminance value can produce it — the defect is upstream of the multiply. Both got named next measurements.

## Two things you should weigh

**I did not patch `psh.c`** — territory.toml:217 gives it to another lane. The prediction and three legs are written out; it needs a board grant or routing.

**Don't let that patch land as a one-liner yet.** `Combiner::CombinerOps` has 6,052 px where B is exactly +1 — same direction, same magnitude, in a suite with no luminance stage. That doesn't prove they're the same mechanism (it also carries ±17 on 5,337 px), but nothing in #10's corpus can distinguish luminance-local from combiner-wide truncation, so a `psh.c:3090` fix would be fitted to one suite. The L2 guard is what would catch it.

Also unrecorded anywhere: **`BumpMap_Y16` is 22,374 wrong**, and **38 of 42 `Bump env lum` tests are broken**, not the two the entry names.
